ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low internal contrast on fluke surface; predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across >95% of the visible area, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized marginal clusters and sparse surface streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity geometric mass. High-intensity clusters located at the extreme distal tips (bilateral). Sparse, thin linear high-intensity clusters mapping to the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees with a vertical depth roughly equal to 12% of the local lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular topography. Left lobe exhibits a prominent wide-amplitude indentation approximately one-third the distance from the notch to the tip. Right lobe trailing edge displays a series of low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations concentrated toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature extending from the central notch to the acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-intensity clusters (rosettes) at the far left tip. A cluster of approximately six small, circular high-intensity points on the outer margin of the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct vertical high-intensity linear streak on the upper-medial surface of the left lobe. Multiple faint, thin curvilinear streaks visible on the lower-lateral quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant traumatic notch or tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch. Irregular marginal erosion on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
